verdict.rationale: Typesense documents an official, first-party hosted MCP server for Typesense Cloud at https://cloud.typesense.org/mcp/v1. It gives a concrete `claude mcp add` connection command, and agents can create clusters, build collections, index data, tune search and read metrics, with user-controlled permissions and disconnect. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, documented MCP support for self-hosted open-source Typesense (evidence covers Cloud only), and detailed tool/auth reference documentation in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect your AI agent to Typesense Cloud and it can create and configure clusters, build collections, index your data, tune search and read metrics, all from the conversation.
claude mcp add --transport http typesense-cloud https://cloud.typesense.org/mcp/v1
You decide what it is allowed to do when you connect it, and you can disconnect it at any time.
